summary: A year of daily counts as a grid of days, a column per week from Monday, shaded by how much happened. Arrow keys move between days.

props.name: data
props.description: One entry per day with activity. Days left out count as zero.

props.name: end
props.description: The last day shown, as `YYYY-MM-DD`. Defaults to today.

props.name: weeks
props.description: How many weeks back from `end`, each a column starting on Monday.

props.name: label
props.description: The heading over the grid, and its accessible name.

props.name: unit
props.description: What a count counts, in the plural, for the total & each day's label.

props.name: locale
props.description: Formats the month and day names.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius on the card and the days. Inherits the nearest `Shape`; under a pill it is rounded, so the days stay squares.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline on each day. `true` draws it, `false` removes it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.
